SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR("d"."service_date" + INTERVAL '23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "serviceDate" , "d"."notification" , ("l"."rosen_code" || '_' || "b"."bus_service_trip_id") AS busServiceTripId , "b"."bus_service_trip_id" AS "busServiceTripIdSort" FROM "daily_bus_daiyas" AS "d" INNER JOIN "bus_services" AS "b" ON "b"."del_flag" = 0 AND "b"."bus_service_id" = "d"."bus_service_id" INNER JOIN "daiya_revisions" AS "dr" ON "dr"."del_flag" = 0 AND "dr"."daiya_revision_id" = "b"."daiya_revision_id" AND "dr"."service_start_date" <= CURRENT_DATE AND "dr"."service_end_date" >= CURRENT_DATE INNER JOIN "lines" AS "l" ON "l"."del_flag" = 0 AND "l"."available_flag" = 1 AND "l"."rosen_id" = "dr"."rosen_id" INNER JOIN "agencies" AS "ag" ON "ag"."del_flag" = 0 AND "ag"."available_flag" = 1 AND "ag"."business_corp_id" = "l"."business_corp_id" AND "ag"."business_corp_id" = #{businessCorpId} WHERE "d"."del_flag" = 0 AND "d"."notification" IS NOT NULL AND "d"."service_date" >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY "serviceDate" ASC, "b"."bus_service_trip_id" ASC
